provenance.changes: Deterministic definition-to-word MCQ templates, option comparisons and randomized distractors; no university provenance.
provenance.verification: Lexical mappings checked against source; NOT independently expert-verified.
provenance.selection: Up to 2,000 unique eligible definitions ordered by lemma frequency, at most one question per lemma; frequency >= 10; sensitivity, domain and answer-leak filters; distractors same POS, different lexicographer category, no known synonym of answer.
